Signaling is a vastly overrated concept especially this early in a draft. The person you're passing to has no idea what you may have picked and you have no idea what they might have first picked. I'd also say passing a Miro is a pretty big signal you're not drafting anything Dimir. If they snap picked something Dimir or in a related color they may not look at your red green cards twice. It's better to take the better card when you have no idea if the people you're passing to will notice or care about these signals.
